modules.module_title: Handle proofing( in case of bread preparation)

pcs.pc_description: set the proof box to the required temperature and humidity following the proofing chart, as per specifications and organization standards
refer to the production chart/proofing chart to understand the loading sequence
load the proof box following the production sequence
monitor proof box parameters such as temperature/humidity
monitor product in the proof box
pull bread at specified heights from proof box
monitor the proof box and product coming out of the proof box
Prepare the proof box by setting parameters such as temperature, humidity, etc., according to product specifications and standard operating procedures.
Prepare and calibrate the oven (in case of batch operation) by pre-heating it to the specified temperature per the oven chart, ensuring it reaches the desired temperature before loading.
Prepare the conveyor (in case of continuous operation) by setting the speed of the conveyor, baking time, and temperature controls, verifying that the desired temperature is reached before loading.
refer to the production chart/proofing chart to understand the loading sequence and process parameters for each product baked
set the oven parameters such as baking temperature and time for the product to be baked
observe filled baking pans (to be loaded in the oven) to determine whether pans are filled to standard
load the ovens with filled baking pans and check that the dough pieces are placed from corner to corner
observe spacing between pans as per defined SOPs
monitor and control the speed of the conveyor to control pans entering the oven and control the baking time of various baking products (in continuous operation)
monitor oven parameters such as temperature and time during baking process
observe the colour of the baking product to detect under/ over baking and to achieve a finished product of uniform quality
unload the oven when the baking process is complete
check the quality of the product through sensory parameters such as colour, size, appearance, texture, and aroma. etc.
unload the pans/trays using proper technique (this must be done immediately after being taken out of the oven to improve the overall shape of the bread)
place the baked product on the cooling racks and transfer it to the cooling room/cooling area
Storage of baked products should be done in such a manner that FIFO is followed.
remove excess waste from the baking pans
stack the emptied baking pans in the designated area
ensure that empty pans are stored appropriately to avoid damage and contamination
adjust or reset the controls of the oven to load the next batch of product
report discrepancies/concerns in each stage of production to the department supervisor for immediate action
select appropriate packaging materials based on product type, storage requirements, and presentation needs.
follow packaging procedures to ensure proper sealing, labelling, and coding of baked goods.
inspect packaged products for defects, ensuring quality standards are met.
pack baked goods according to customer orders or standard packaging configurations.
store packaged products in designated areas, maintaining proper temperature and humidity levels.
follow FIFO (First In, First Out) principles for inventory management of packaged goods.
operate automated packaging equipment (if applicable), ensuring smooth product flow and proper sealing.
visually inspect and cleans packaging materials to ensure they are free of debris or damage before use.

modules.module_title: Post-production cleaning and regular maintenance of equipment

pcs.pc_description: clean and sanitise the work area, machinery, equipment, and tools according to established cleaning schedules and standard operating procedures (SOPs), using appropriate food-grade cleaning agents and sanitisers.
properly disassemble and reassemble equipment for thorough cleaning and sanitation, following manufacturer instructions and safety protocols

perform routine troubleshooting and minor repairs on baking equipment, following manufacturer guidelines and safety procedures. Report any major malfunctions or repairs requiring specialised expertise to the appropriate personnel.

implement and maintain a preventative maintenance program for all baking equipment, including regular inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and calibration. Document maintenance activities and follow SOPs for reporting and addressing maintenance needs.
maintain accurate records of equipment maintenance and repairs, including dates, actions taken, and parts used.
